name: Raw Grid
description: Neobrutalist presentation system where 3px solid black borders ARE the layout. System sans-serif at weight 900 uppercase for all display — no web fonts loaded. White canvas + black structure + two muted pastel accents (blush pink and sage green) + neutral gray. Hard offset shadows in solid black at 6px and 4px — never blurred, never colored. Oversized decorative numerals at 0.15–0.35 opacity sit behind content as wallpaper. Black label pills are the universal section tag. Zero rounded corners, zero gradients, zero softness.
descriptionZh: 新野蛮主义演示系统，3px 实心黑边框即布局。系统无衬线字体 900 粗细大写展示——不加载网络字体。白色画布 + 黑色结构 + 两种柔和粉彩强调色（粉红和鼠尾草绿）+ 中性灰。6px/4px 实心黑色硬偏移阴影——无模糊、无彩色。超大装饰性数字以 0.15-0.35 不透明度作为壁纸衬在内容后方。黑色标签药丸为通用章节标签。
avoidFor: 需要柔和、温暖或有意图安静氛围的场景
